full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiff was that plot No.6428 comprising an area of 26 acre land under C.S Khatian No.216 belonged to Jabeda Nessa and others. Plot No.6438 was exclusively possessed by Haran amicably, Plot No.6432 was exclusively possessed by Jabeda Nessa and Ayaton Nessa. Ayaton Nessa was the wife of Haran Biswas. Ayaton Nessa and Haran died leaving behind only son, Sabder Ali. Sabder and Jabeda transferred their shares in favour of Harej Biswas by dint of settlement 44/45 years before and dakhila was granted in favour of Harej Biswas by Jabeda and Sabder, After settlement, Harej Biswas decided that he would gift .24 acre land from Plot No.2632 to his wife in lieu of her dower, but in order to save the registration expenses. Harej Biswas transferred .24 acre land from Plot No.6432 by dint of settlement. The S.A. record was wrongly prepared in the name of Rais and Sarafat Biswas in respect of Plot No.6432, but nobody's name was recorded in Plot No.6428. Harej Biswas was childless for which he transferred the rest portion of land of Plot Nos. 6432 and 6428 to his wife -Gulejan. Harej Biswas died leaving behind wife-Gulejan Nessa. Gulejan transferred her share in favour of the plaintiff on 11.05.1979. Due to the old age of Gulejan, the plaintiff kept her in his residence. Taking the advantage of the short absence of the plaintiff, defendant No.1 took away Gulejan from his residence on 29.06.1979 over which a village Salish was held and a criminal case was instituted later on. Gulejan died on 15.03.1980. Defendant Nos.1 and 2 denied the plain-tiffs title and claimed their own title in the suit land; hence the suit.
